exposure: cCTG parameters obtained outside of labor
binary clinical variables describing the presence or absence of pregnancy pathologies
cohort: The study included 694 singleton high-risk pregnancies complicated by gestational diabetes, preexisting diabetes, intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy, pregnancy-induced or preexisting hypertension, or fetal growth restriction.
finding: Machine learning models, particularly Random Forest, integrating cCTG features with maternal clinical factors accurately predicted neonatal hospitalization duration in pregnancies complicated by maternal or fetal disease, with an average error of approximately 2 days.
gest_age: Gestational age at monitoring and at delivery were included as features in the models.
